mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eg_check_account_middle_result_his (record_id, period_code, currency_type, org_id, account_code, client_code, contract_code, bank_account, bill_contract_code, account_remain_balance, kingdee_remain_balance, diff_flag, diff_balance, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) select ${param.recordId}, tmp.period_code,tmp.currency,tmp.org_id,tmp.account_code,tmp.client_code,tmp.contract_code, tmp.bank_account,tmp.bill_contract_code, -- tmp.debit_amount, case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then coalesce(tmp.debit_amount,0) - coalesce(tmp.credit_amount,0) when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then coalesce(tmp.credit_amount,0) - coalesce(tmp.debit_amount,0) else 0 end as account_remain_balance, -- ecamt.debit_amount, case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then coalesce(ecamt.debit_amount,0) - coalesce(ecamt.credit_amount,0) when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then coalesce(ecamt.credit_amount,0) - coalesce(ecamt.debit_amount,0) else 0 end as kingdee_remain_balance, -- case when ecamt.debit_amount = tmp.debit_amount then '0' else '1' end del_flag, case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' and coalesce(tmp.debit_amount,0) - coalesce(tmp.credit_amount,0) = coalesce(ecamt.debit_amount,0) - coalesce(ecamt.credit_amount,0) then '0' when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' and coalesce(tmp.credit_amount,0) - coalesce(tmp.debit_amount,0) = coalesce(ecamt.credit_amount,0) - coalesce(ecamt.debit_amount,0) then '0' else 1 end del_flag, -- coalesce(ecamt.debit_amount,0) - coalesce(tmp.debit_amount,0), case when ea.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then coalesce(tmp.debit_amount,0) - coalesce(tmp.credit_amount,0) - (coalesce(ecamt.debit_amount,0) - coalesce(ecamt.credit_amount,0)) when ea.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then coalesce(tmp.credit_amount,0) - coalesce(tmp.debit_amount,0) - (coalesce(ecamt.credit_amount,0) - coalesce(ecamt.debit_amount,0)) else 0 end diff_balance, '0', ${param.createBy}, now(), ${param.updateBy}, now() from ( select ev.period_code, to_char(ev.business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') business_date, to_char(ev.voucher_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') voucher_date, ev.system_code , ev.org_id , eve.contract_code , ec.eas_code, eve.client_code , eve.bank_account , eve.bill_contract_code , eve.account_code , ev.currency , sum(eve.debit_amount) debit_amount, sum(eve.credit_amount) credit_amount from eg_voucher_entry eve join eg_voucher ev on eve.voucher_id = ev.id left join eg_currency ec on ev.currency = ec.currency_code -- join eg_account ea on eve.account_code = ea.account_code -- and ea.check_flag = '1' where 1=1--to_char(ev.create_time,'YYYY-MM-DD')='2024-03-02' and ev.period_code = #{param.periodCode} group by to_char(ev.business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd'),to_char(ev.voucher_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), ev.system_code , ev.org_id , eve.contract_code , eve.client_code , eve.bank_account , eve.bill_contract_code , eve.account_code , ev.currency, ec.eas_code, ev.period_code ) tmp join eg_check_account_middle_tmp ecamt on tmp.org_id = ecamt.org_id and tmp.contract_code = ecamt.contract_code and tmp.eas_code = ecamt.currency_type and tmp.client_code = ecamt.client_code and tmp.account_code = ecamt.account_code and coalesce(tmp.bank_account,'') = coalesce(ecamt.bank_account,'') and coalesce(tmp.bill_contract_code,'') = coalesce(ecamt.bill_contract_code,'') and tmp.period_code = ecamt.period_code join eg_account ea on ecamt.account_code = ea.account_code and ea.check_flag = '1'

INSERT INTO eg_check_account_middle_result_his (record_id, period_code, currency_type, org_id, account_code, client_code, contract_code, bank_account, bill_contract_code, account_remain_balance, kingdee_remain_balance, diff_flag, diff_balance, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) SELECT record_id, period_code, currency_type, org_id, account_code, client_code, contract_code, bank_account, bill_contract_code, account_remain_balance, kingdee_remain_balance, diff_flag, diff_balance, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM eg_check_account_middle_result
